Licenses of the bundled third-party components
==============================================

engine/godot          Godot Engine 4.5.1 - MIT license (godot-LICENSE.txt),
                      third-party parts: godot-COPYRIGHT.txt
game/bin/libfe7hd.so  contains:
  godot-rust (gdext) 0.5.5  - Mozilla Public License 2.0 (godot-rust-MPL-2.0.txt),
                              unmodified source: https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext
  glam 0.32               - MIT or Apache-2.0 (glam-LICENSE-MIT.txt)
  libc 0.2                - MIT or Apache-2.0 (libc-LICENSE-MIT.txt)
Fonts (game/fonts):
  IM FELL English Roman   - SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-imfell.txt)
  Uncial Antiqua          - SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-uncial.txt)
  PT Sans Narrow Bold     - SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-ptsans.txt)

Not included: game data of Nintendo / Intelligent Systems. Graphics, font,
text, music and game logic are read at runtime from the player's own ROM.
game/ui/frames.json only contains addresses inside the ROM.
